changelog: - **The marketing account import runs from the admin panel — no CLI, no outside database connection** (#2552, story #2391). The CLI could never run where the data is: the runner image ships neither `scripts/` nor `src/lib/*.ts` and is `node:20-slim`, while the CLI needs `--experimental-strip-types`; and connecting to production from outside is what `docs/DATA_ACCESS_POLICY.md` rules out. `/admin/settings`' import card gains a **Marketing accounts** mode (MARKETING orgs only, and the one they open on): pick or paste the file, choose the default owner (you, or another active admin/rep of the org) and whether the file may overwrite disagreeing values, **Preview** (dry run), then **Apply** — offered only after a preview of exactly that input and confirmed once. The report shows New / Update / Unchanged / Skipped / Error counts and every row needing attention. `POST /api/admin/import/marketing-accounts` is a thin door onto the SAME engine the CLI calls (`runMarketingAccountImport()` → `runImport` with the preview or the database writer — no second parser, no second dry-run path): ADMIN only (a MENTOR gets 403), `requireCapability` on `companies` and `pipeline`, and — because INTERNSHIP carries every capability, so the capability gate can never refuse it — the vertical itself, answered `403 vertical_mismatch` for anything but MARKETING; `withRequestScope` + `withTenantScope`, the session's org only (nothing in the body names one), `TEXT_LIMITS.marketingImportFile` (2 000 000 chars → 413 `file_too_large`) and `MARKETING_IMPORT_MAX_ROWS` (5 000 → 413 `too_many_rows`, checked on the shared parser's output before anything is planned), 30 runs per admin per 10 minutes. The response carries per-row status/key/name/reason/changed only, never the plan's input fields. On apply the existing `marketing.accounts.imported` activity row is written with counts only, now naming the acting admin as actor when the owner is someone else. `runMarketingAccountImport` gains `owner`, `actor`, `request` and `maxRows` options; the CLI is unchanged. `e2e/marketing-account-import.spec.ts`: the sample file previews 6 New / 0 Error and writes nothing, apply lands 6 accounts, 5 external ids and the fixture's trial windows, a second apply is 6 Unchanged; INTERNSHIP sees no mode and gets `vertical_mismatch`, a MARKETING rep gets 403 (also added to the `MARKETING_MENTOR_ADMIN_ONLY` probe list). `docs/marketing-import.md` § Running it now leads with the panel. An apply holds a per-org `JobLease` (`marketing-import:<orgId>`) for its run, so a second concurrent apply answers `409 import_running` instead of creating VAT-less accounts twice; the body is read through a byte-bounded reader (413 while streaming); an unpicked owner falls back to the org's default lead owner (#2562) before the signed-in admin, and the report names the owner used.

en: Marketing organisations can import their customer table themselves: Settings → import → "Marketing accounts". Preview the file first — nothing is written — then apply it; running the same file again changes nothing.
Imported accounts can carry their product id and their trial and customer-since dates, so imported trials get their reminders like any other.
tr: Pazarlama organizasyonları müşteri tablolarını artık kendileri içe aktarabiliyor: Ayarlar → içe aktarma → "Pazarlama hesapları". Önce dosyayı önizleyin — hiçbir şey yazılmaz — sonra uygulayın; aynı dosyayı yeniden çalıştırmak hiçbir şeyi değiştirmez.
İçe aktarılan hesaplar ürün kimliklerini, deneme ve müşteri olma tarihlerini taşıyabiliyor; böylece içe aktarılan denemeler de hatırlatmalarını alıyor.
de: Marketing-Organisationen können ihre Kundentabelle jetzt selbst importieren: Einstellungen → Import → „Marketing-Konten“. Zuerst die Vorschau prüfen — dabei wird nichts geschrieben —, dann übernehmen; derselbe Lauf ein zweites Mal ändert nichts.
Importierte Konten können ihre Produkt-ID sowie Test- und Kunde-seit-Daten mitbringen, sodass importierte Testphasen ihre Erinnerungen wie alle anderen erhalten.
